reuse.why: The range rule is changed inside the shared getScheduledAmount and its rounding option is dropped, but api-models.ts keeps its own copy of the rule, edited in parallel instead of calling the helper.

duplication.why: Leaves two definitions of the ranged-amount rule (shared/schedules.ts and scheduleModel.toExternal) and the approximate-tolerance rule still lives only inline in schedule-template.ts.

placement.why: The range part sits in shared/schedules.ts, but the approximate part of the same 'lowest value it allows' rule stays in the budget template module and the API model holds its own copy.

scope.why: Only the rule sites and their tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Removing the rounding option simplifies the helper, but the next change to the rule still has to be made in two or three places that can drift apart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount with its own Math.min expression instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The api-models copy is the same missing/number/range dispatch as getScheduledAmount written inline; it is kept openly, not disguised.
